correctness.rationale: A complete ten-vertex check gives 537 admissible faces, 268 disjoint acyclic Hasse pairs and the sole unpaired dimension-five face 876. A matched empty face and vertex yield a standard nonaugmented acyclic matching with a critical vertex and a five-cell. Global face support never exceeds three petals; all at-most-two-petal faces form a hub cone; three-petal blocks intersect each other only inside that cone. The CW quotient is a wedge of binomial(m,3) sphere-equivalent block quotients. Integer homology follows from the homotopy type, without extrapolation.
